title: Origin of the crossing-count exponent
html: The crossing-count exponent q^{\mathrm{cr}(\pi)} in the pair-partition moment formula arises directly from the braid relation \sigma_i \sigma_{i+1} \sigma_i = \sigma_{i+1} \sigma_i \sigma_{i+1}. Each non-trivial reordering of a crossing pair contributes q (positive crossing) or q^{-1} (negative crossing). The Blitvić (q, t)-Gaussian with t=1 recovers this crossing-weighted combinatorics exactly.
